name: IXI: Information eXtraction from Images Brain MRI Dataset
description: The IXI Dataset (Information eXtraction from Images) is an open-access collection of multi-contrast brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans acquired from nearly 600 healthy adult subjects. Collected across three major London clinical centers (Hammersmith Hospital on a Philips 3T scanner, Guy's Hospital on a Philips 1.5T scanner, and the Institute of Psychiatry on a GE 1.5T scanner) under an EPSRC-funded project, the dataset includes T1-weighted, T2-weighted, Proton Density (PD)-weighted, Magnetic Resonance Angiography (MRA), and 15-direction Diffusion-Weighted (DTI) images. Accompanying demographic variables include subject age, sex, height, weight, and education level. IXI serves as a standard normative reference cohort for neuroimaging research, including brain age prediction, multi-modal MRI registration, tissue segmentation, and image synthesis.
